answer: Tie each identity to one live attestor drawn from a capped annual allotment. Keys are free and commodity silicon is a relic, but a liable sponsor is not: the allotment is fixed, so its clearing price rises with every unit one buyer takes, and k identities cost k times an increasing price - superlinear by construction, not by decree. Renewal is serial and per name; lapse decays weight to zero, and the ledger stamps each dead tenure in umber so churn stays visible. Attestors are an orchard of separate plots: a farm cannot take one more tree, it must buy the whole orchard.
